title: Prime-power and shared-order cofactor exclusions for Agrawal's conjecture
field: computational number theory and primality testing
decided_scope: all prime powers p^e (e>=2) for odd p<=100,000 and r in {5,7,11,13,17,19,23,29,31}, and all 12,286 shared-order prime-subset candidates
open_boundaries: the unrestricted Agrawal conjecture for general squarefree composites
